observations: Four channels each transfer17u32; source/destination/guards verified twice after halt. Buffers retained until reset.
IRQ58 delivers four recorded notifications, one for each channel; completion mask retains raw TC, unmask delivers; error-only mask does not deliver TC.
Channel1 completion clear preserves channel0 TC; writing error clear does not clear TC. Events are acknowledged only after normal-context transfer validation.
Channel3 completes while local IRQ is disabled. Clearing LOCIPCLR58 while the peripheral source remains asserted then enabling local delivery still yields IRQ58 on hardware.
Old model loses fourth notification after LOCIPCLR58; fixed model re-samples only source58 on clear. Same ELF passes three consecutive physical/QEMU rounds.
limits: Completion interrupts tested, physical bus-error interrupt injection not performed.
No physical drain proof, safe buffer return, peripheral handshake IRQ, async/waker cancellation, SDMA or production multicore handoff qualification.
IRQ58 behavior after peripheral deassertion or trap-entry auto-clear is not inferred; IRQ72 retained-pending model remains separate.
Four-channel u32 IRQ fixture; u8/u16 data copy coverage is in the previous memory HIL, not this IRQ experiment.
No Flash/eFuse/security writes; original firmware recovered after every RAM run.
